text: Unable to pass during the battle!!
The water that should be flowing is probably\nblocked somewhere.\nLet's try to find a side road!
You were running at full speed to get here first\nthough.
I-I couldn't help it!\nI'm desperate to get my bag back!
But we don't know where to look for it, pom.\nShould we split up, pom?
What's wrong...?\nHey?! I thought we just came from here, didn't we?
This is bad.\nThat means we can't use the trees in this valley\nto mark our way.
At this rate, we won't even know how to get back,\nlet alone rescue Olant...\nWait, I don't see Potumkin anywhere.
Looks like it's better if we stick together.\nAnyway, let's find where that kid got taken to!
The atmosphere here is different.\nI can see living things.
I wonder if they're living things...\nOkay whatever.\nI personally find it creepier here...
Uhm...But it's kinda weird to find water pooling\nin a place like this.
The water that should be flowing is probably\nblocked somewhere.\nLet's try to find a side road!
Oh!\nLooks like those things are blocking the water!
In that case, you need to beat them and destroy\nthe wood and rocks that are stopping the water\nfrom flowing!
Phew, we somehow got through it.
Now we can cross, can't we?\nShall we go on ahead?
I didn't expect you to get this far. Who are you?
It doesn't matter who we are!\nGive me back my bag!\nAnd those 2 kids you kidnapped too!
Oh, impressive!\nSo you knew that this is where I, the Crimson\nMoon Witch, live.
Fine. I don't mind seeing you.\nBut on one condition.
Of course, you must make offerings to me...\nWell, for example a young and energetic witch.
H-hey, what are you doing to me?!\nPut me down!!
You have nothing you can give to me as offerings,\ndo you...? You'd better leave and come back later.
What else do you want?! You already took my bag!\nI repeat, my B-A-G!\nIs that not enough?!
I wonder what this is...\nThey look like drawings of a spider, a bat, and a\nmouse though...
D-don't tell me these animals...\nare the offerings she wants us to bring to her?!
Ugh, o-okay, fine! It seems like the gate will\nopen if we make an offering at the 3 altars.\nLet's bring her the offerings quickly!
Looks like we can go through now!\nAlright! Let's go!
